explication: Vineflower is a Java and JVM-language decompiler, usable from the console or as a library. The principal workflow is to accept class files or archives, parse class and method structures, reconstruct control flow and expressions, then emit formatted source. Java 21+ constructs, multithreaded decompilation, and Kotlin/Scala plugin support are notable capabilities. The README documents the user-facing workflow; source excerpts and the index support selected internals, so unverified internal handoffs are shown as dashed.
